source.title: Clementine uv750 Global Basemap v2 Mosaic
source.credit: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / Clementine UVVIS

processing: USGS WMS uv_v2 global 750 nm mosaic exported at 2048x1024 JPEG, EPSG:4326, without project recoloring; immutable SHA-256-bound copy.
limitations: 1994 Clementine 750 nm grayscale mosaic, not natural color or a current LROC image.

Original missing-data regions occur at middle and low latitudes as well as the poles. Some appear as dark rectangular patches in this opaque export; these patches are not lunar terrain or current shadows.

WMS resampling and JPEG artifacts limit surface detail; brightness is not calibrated visual photometry. This export has no validity mask, so near-black pixels must not be treated uniformly as missing data.
